# PHP Symfony Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Backend > PHP

## Overview

Builds enterprise PHP applications with Symfony including Doctrine ORM, Twig templates, security, and dependency injection container

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [php-symfony-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
php-symfony-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@php-symfony-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Build Symfony applications with proper bundle structure
- Configure dependency injection with autowiring
- Implement Doctrine entities with proper mapping
- Build security with voters and access control

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Symfony Best Practices**: Official Symfony patterns and conventions
- **Doctrine ORM**: Entity mapping and query patterns
- **Symfony Security**: Authentication and authorization patterns
